mechanism: Fluphenazine is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may decrease anastrozole metabolism, potentially increasing anastrozole exposure and estrogenic effects; both drugs also carry anticholinergic and CNS effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for anastrozole efficacy and side effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with minimal CYP3A4 interaction if possible; ensure adequate aromatase inhibition in breast cancer management.
